tool_input.code:
import openpyxl, os
p=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p)
ws=wb['SH']
# collect kept rows (2..max) that are non-blank across A:L
maxr=ws.max_row
kept=[]
for r in range(2,maxr+1):
    vals=[ws.cell(row=r,column=c).value for c in range(1,13)]
    if any(v is not None and str(v).strip()!='' for v in vals):
        kept.append(vals)
# clear all data rows 2..maxr
for r in range(2,maxr+1):
    for c in range(1,13):
        ws.cell(row=r,column=c).value=None
# write kept rows starting at row 2
for i,vals in enumerate(kept):
    r=2+i
    for c,v in enumerate(vals,start=1):
        ws.cell(row=r,column=c).value=v
wb.save(p)
print('kept',len(kept))
